text:
Samantha Cheng: heads up — main CI turned red right after my merge (PR #5124). smoke-gpu matrix is failing intermittently, looks like a memory spike in the batching tests. any quick eyes?
Javier Morales: on it. which job id? any error snippet?
Samantha Cheng: job 12834 (post-merge), repeated failures in BatchingTest::prefix_cache_eviction. low signal so far, failure doesn't repro locally.
Maya Patel: can we rerun the job first? might be transient. @ci-bot can you kick a rerun? :pray:
ci-bot: Re-run requested by @Maya Patel — pipeline #12834 requeued as #12834.rerun1. Status: queued. :gear:
Lin Zhao: if rerun fails, can someone grab the node logs and dmesg — I want to rule out driver OOM vs allocator bug.
Tom Nguyen: grabbing logs from the runner now. quick paste of the failing test tail:
```
E 2025-07-25T14:04:12.345Z AllocFailure: CUDA malloc failed: out of memory
Test: BatchingTest::prefix_cache_eviction (shard 2) ... FAILED
Stack: Redwood::runtime::kvcache::alloc +0x1f2
```
Tom Nguyen: also seeing repeated small allocations before the big fail, could be a leak in the new batching path.
Javier Morales: thanks — that stack points at the new continuous-batcher change in the PR. @Samantha Cheng did you change anything that touched KV cache lifecycle?
Samantha Cheng: only a couple lines to avoid extra copies in the batcher, nothing touching cache eviction explicitly. I can revert quickly if we need to test.
Maya Patel: rerun finished: #12834.rerun1 -> failed with same trace.
ops-bot: Incident note: main CI red (smoke-gpu) — flagged for triage.
Lin Zhao: ok let's bisect to narrow down. @Javier can you run a binary bisection between main pre-PR and post-PR? try to isolate to a commit. If it lands on PR5124 we can revert.
Javier Morales: starting a quick bisect job now (approx 6 commits to try) — will post results.
Tom Nguyen: in parallel, @Samantha can you open an emergency revert PR? if bisect implicates your change we should revert fast.
Samantha Cheng: opening revert now (WIP) — PR 5124-revert. will hold if bisect says otherwise.
ci-bot: Bisect job #12835 started by @Javier Morales. ETA ~12m.
Maya Patel: also adding a quick smoke that throttles batch size to verify if it's a memory pressure regression. will run locally and on canary.
Javier Morales: bisect done — first failing commit is the merge of PR #5124 (confirmed).
Tom Nguyen: thanks — please merge the revert and I'll monitor the next pipeline.
Samantha Cheng: revert PR opened and merged (PR 5130). triggering a full post-merge pipeline now.
ci-bot: Pipeline triggered: #12836 (post-revert).
Maya Patel: monitoring logs, canary run looks clean so far.
ops-bot: Update: main CI status: recovering after revert. Closing triage unless new failures appear. :white_check_mark:
Samantha Cheng: really sorry for the churn — will follow up with a deeper debug tomorrow and add more unit tests around batcher allocation.
Lin Zhao: thanks for the quick ops. long-term: add a memory-safety check in smoke to catch this earlier.
Maya Patel: +1 to adding the cheaper memory guard.
Javier Morales: noted — adding a short postmortem to the incident doc with root cause and mitigation steps.
Tom Nguyen: leaving notes on the revert PR for follow-up.
Samantha Cheng: thanks team! :heart:
